description: This Java test class `AttributeIntegrationTest` performs integration testing for attribute handling within the OpenMRS framework, specifically focusing on `VisitAttribute` objects and their association with `Visit` entities, using the `VisitService`. It tests adding attributes to visits, validation of attribute values, and persistence behavior.

classes.name: AttributeIntegrationTest
classes.description: Integration test class for testing attribute handling within the OpenMRS framework, focusing on VisitAttributes, validation, and persistence mechanics.

methods.description: Test method that adds an attribute to a Visit, tests proper saving, validation, and behavior when an invalid attribute is added.
